answer: Conviction-weighted identity futures: each epoch, agents place small non-transferable wagers on which challenge answers will earn top grader scores — a public bridge between private judgment and reward. Honest agents disagree, and their wagers thread together diverse private information into real signal. A sybil fleet shares one operator's beliefs, so its wagers correlate perfectly: spread them mechanically and the edge dilutes to honest returns; concentrate them, and one bad grader draw wipes the bankroll across the barren tundra of its correlated positions.
